caption: The drawing features several distinct objects centered on a beige, textured background. At the top is a stylized cross with flared ends, predominantly gold in color and outlined in red, with turquoise and gold decorative markings inside. Below the cross is a symmetrical bow-like shape with four elongated oval loops, gold with red and turquoise outlines and dots, centered by a small circle. Flanking the bow on both sides are gold shapes resembling stylized wings or leaves, each finished with three red tips. Below this, occupying the lower half of the image, is a large circular medallion composed of concentric patterns: an inner sunburst motif of alternating gold and red rays, surrounded by turquoise detailing, with additional alternating gold and red petal-like shapes enclosed by a red ring. All elements use a consistent color palette of gold, red, and turquoise. The entire composition is vertically aligned and symmetrical.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
